proof:
Source: steps 3 and 4 of the parent proof, with the ball-mass inequality (B) as a hypothesis.
Notation: ω_n := unitBallVolume n = volume(ball (0 : Euclid n) 1) and V(r) := ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ).
1. (V(r) is positive and finite.) Unfold unitBallVolume: ω_n is the volume of an open ball of positive radius in the finite-dimensional Euclidean space Euclid n. The volume is an open-positive measure, so ω_n > 0 (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume 0 one_pos). It is finite on compacts and Euclid n is proper, so ω_n < ∞ (measure_ball_lt_top). For r > 0, rⁿ > 0 (pow_pos), so ofReal(rⁿ) > 0 (ENNReal.ofReal_pos); also ofReal(rⁿ) ≠ ∞ (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top). Hence V(r) ≠ 0 for r > 0 (mul_ne_zero) and V(r) ≠ ∞ for every r (ENNReal.mul_ne_top).
2. (a) Since η₁ > 0, η₁/2 < η₁, so ofReal(η₁/2) < ofReal η₁ (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff). With (L), ofReal(η₁/2) < liminf m(r)/V(r). By Filter.eventually_lt_of_lt_liminf, ofReal(η₁/2) < m(r)/V(r) eventually in 𝓝[>] 0. In the complete lattice [0,∞] the boundedness side condition holds automatically: apply the lemma with all explicit arguments via exact, and its default autoParam discharges it.
3. (b) By (D) and K ≠ ∞, ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul gives K·(o(r)/V(r)) → K·0 = 0 along 𝓝[>] 0 (rewrite with mul_zero). Since η₁/4 > 0, ofReal(η₁/4) > 0, so by tendsto_order, K·(o(r)/V(r)) < ofReal(η₁/4) eventually in 𝓝[>] 0.
4. (c) By (U), limsup H(r)/V(r) ≤ 1 < 2. So by Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt, H(r)/V(r) < 2 eventually in 𝓝[>] 0 (same remark on the autoParam).
5. The conjunction of (a), (b) and (c) holds eventually in 𝓝[>] 0 (Filter.Eventually.and). By mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset there is r₀ > 0 such that (a), (b) and (c) hold for every r ∈ (0, r₀). Fix such an r and write V := V(r); by step 1, V ≠ 0 and V ≠ ∞.
6. (Clearing denominators.) From (a), ENNReal.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (with V ≠ 0, V ≠ ∞) gives ofReal(η₁/2)·V < m(r), so ofReal(η₁/2)·V ≤ m(r). From (b), K·(o(r)/V) = (K·o(r))/V (mul_div_assoc), so ENNReal.div_lt_iff gives K·o(r) < ofReal(η₁/4)·V, hence K·o(r) ≤ ofReal(η₁/4)·V. From (c), ENNReal.div_lt_iff gives H(r) < 2·V, hence H(r) ≤ 2·V(r): this is the asserted upper bound.
7. (Splitting.) η₁/2 = η₁/4 + η₁/4 with both summands ≥ 0. So ofReal(η₁/2) = ofReal(η₁/4) + ofReal(η₁/4) (ENNReal.ofReal_add, ring), and ofReal(η₁/2)·V = ofReal(η₁/4)·V + ofReal(η₁/4)·V (add_mul).
8. (Cancelling.) By step 7, step 6, hypothesis (B) at r > 0, and step 6 again: ofReal(η₁/4)·V + ofReal(η₁/4)·V = ofReal(η₁/2)·V ≤ m(r) ≤ ofReal θ₀·h(r) + K·o(r) ≤ ofReal θ₀·h(r) + ofReal(η₁/4)·V (gcongr). The summand ofReal(η₁/4)·V is finite (ENNReal.mul_ne_top with ofReal_ne_top and V ≠ ∞). Cancelling it on the right (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_right) gives ofReal(η₁/4)·V ≤ ofReal θ₀·h(r).
9. (Dividing by θ₀.) Since θ₀ > 0, ofReal θ₀ ≠ 0 (ENNReal.ofReal_pos) and ofReal θ₀ ≠ ∞. Next, (ofReal θ₀)⁻¹ = ofReal(θ₀⁻¹) (ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos), and ofReal(θ₀⁻¹)·ofReal(η₁/4) = ofReal(θ₀⁻¹·(η₁/4)) (ENNReal.ofReal_mul, θ₀⁻¹ ≥ 0). Since θ₀⁻¹·(η₁/4) = η₁/(4θ₀) (field_simp, θ₀ ≠ 0), we get ofReal(η₁/(4θ₀)) = (ofReal θ₀)⁻¹·ofReal(η₁/4). Therefore ofReal(η₁/(4θ₀))·V = (ofReal θ₀)⁻¹·(ofReal(η₁/4)·V) (mul_assoc). By step 8 and monotonicity of multiplication, this is ≤ (ofReal θ₀)⁻¹·(ofReal θ₀·h(r)). That equals h(r) by mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (ofReal θ₀ ≠ 0, ≠ ∞) and one_mul. This is the asserted lower bound. Together with step 6, both bounds hold for every r with 0 < r < r₀. ∎

Eventually in 𝓝[>] 0: ofReal(η₁/2) < m/V by (L), K·(o/V) < ofReal(η₁/4) by (D), and H/V < 2 by (U). Choose r₀ via mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.
Clear denominators for 0 < r < r₀: ofReal(η₁/2)·V ≤ m(r), K·o(r) ≤ ofReal(η₁/4)·V, and H(r) ≤ 2V.
Split ofReal(η₁/2)·V into two quarters, combine with (B), and cancel the finite quarter: ofReal(η₁/4)·V ≤ ofReal θ₀·h(r).
Divide by ofReal θ₀ ∈ (0,∞): ofReal(η₁/(4θ₀))·V ≤ h(r).
